summary.headline: Create a Slack app via the developer portal, configure OAuth redirect URLs, and request scopes to enable user installation.
summary.type_note: Test mode is self-serve; production public distribution may need review

difficulty_factors.reason: Requires logging into a Slack account to access the app management portal.
Distributing publicly or requesting sensitive scopes may require Slack app directory review, but internal/workspace apps are self-serve.
No official review wait time published for general apps; workspace distribution is instant.
Creating a Slack app and testing OAuth does not require a paid plan.
Requires human login to the Slack developer dashboard.

approval_wait.label: Instant for workspace installation; variable if submitting to App Directory

can_start_today.reason: You can view documentation and the app creation portal immediately, but logging in and creating credentials requires a human user account.

confidence.reason: Verified official endpoints and developer portal existence via public probes.

blockers.title: Login Required for App Creation
blockers.detail: Creating and managing Slack apps requires authenticating with a Slack user account.
blockers.workaround: Log in manually to the Slack API dashboard.

steps.title: Create a Slack App
steps.action: Go to the Slack API apps page, sign in, and click 'Create New App'.
steps.why_human_only: Requires authentication with a Slack account.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Redirect URLs
steps.action: Navigate to 'OAuth & Permissions' in your app settings and add your redirect URL.

steps.title: Add Scopes
steps.action: Under 'OAuth & Permissions', add the required Bot or User token scopes for your agent.

scopes.purpose: View basic information about public channels in a workspace
Send messages on behalf of the app

common_rejection_reasons.reason: Invalid redirect URI mismatch during OAuth handshake
common_rejection_reasons.fix: Ensure the redirect URL configured in the Slack app dashboard matches the exact callback URL sent by your application.
